instructionsBlocks:
SVG
Icons are embedded as inline SVG in Astro components so their size and color can be controlled without an external runtime. Update the relevant component in src/components/ to replace an icon, keeping its viewBox and accessible label.
For new assets, export clean SVG from your design tool, review its markup, and use it directly in the appropriate Astro component. Keep interactive controls as native buttons or links.
